units.source_text: 源氏公子定于三月二十后离京。

en.t: Prince Genji decided to leave the capital after the twentieth day of the third month.

units.source_text: 对外人并不宣布行期，只带平素亲近的侍从七八人，非常秘密地出发了。

en.t: He did not announce his departure date to outsiders, and set out in great secrecy with only seven or eight attendants who were usually close to him.

units.source_text: 出发以前，只写几封信向几个知心人告别，绝不声张，悄悄地送去。

en.t: Before leaving, he wrote only a few letters to bid farewell to several intimate friends, made no announcement at all, and had them delivered quietly.

units.source_text: 然而信都写得缠绵悱恻，语重心长，其中定有动人的好文章。

en.t: Yet all the letters were written with deep tenderness and sorrow, their words earnest and weighty, and among them there must surely have been moving passages of fine writing.

units.source_text: 可惜作者那时也心情混乱，无意仔细探访，未能记述为憾。

en.t: Unfortunately, the author too was emotionally unsettled at the time and had no heart to inquire carefully, so it is regrettable that she was unable to record them.
